snippet.title: 【ニュース】“雲海”観光地で殺人未遂事件　見知らぬ男が軽トラで突っ込みバールで殴りかかる #shorts
snippet.description:
■“雲海”観光地で殺人未遂事件
事件が起きたのは北海道の雲海で有名な公園です。

訪れた53歳の男性は絶景を眺めていたところ、突然、軽トラックが…。その時、運転していた男が大声を上げているのが聞えたといいます。

男性をはね、車はそのまま斜面を10メートルほど転落しました。

ところが、これで終わりではなく、男は斜面をバールを持って上がってきたというのです。全く知らない男でした。

バールで男性に殴り掛かってきたといい、さらに押し倒し、馬乗りになって暴行したとみられています。

男性は右肩甲骨を折るなどの重傷です。

4日に殺人未遂の疑いで逮捕されたのは、住所不定・職業不詳の今野康幸容疑者（54）です。

今野容疑者の供述
「わざとじゃない、アクセルとブレーキを踏み間違えたかもしれない。バールは相手に殴られそうになったから構えた」

今野容疑者は覚醒剤取締法違反などの疑いでも摘発されています。

snippet.title: Lions Overpower a Crocodile and Steal Her Hatchlings
snippet.description:
🐊 A mother crocodile guards her nest against a pride of 8 lions 🦁

☀️ It’s midday on a quiet riverbank. A mother Nile crocodile lies beside her nest, and her eggs are starting to hatch 🥚🐣. Then a pride of eight lions comes down the slope, drawn by the nest.

⚔️ She refuses to move. The lions circle her and test her from every side, but every time they get close, her jaws snap shut in a flash. Then a second crocodile comes out of the river to stand with her, and the fight splits in two 💥. Some lions go after the mother, some after the newcomer. They work in pairs, one drawing the jaws while the other strikes from behind.

😨 Between attacks the lions pull back, growling from a safe distance and waiting for an opening. Then one lioness gets too close and is grabbed, and the whole pride charges in to free her 🦁🦁🦁.

🌊 Worn out, the second crocodile slips back into the river. The mother is left alone with the entire pride, still holding her nest 💔. Does she save her hatchlings? Watch to the end 👀

snippet.title: Russian Soldier Dodges Three Ukrainian Drone Attacks #ukraine #drone #drones #russia #fpvdrone #fpv
snippet.description:
Footage from the Ukraine war shows a Russian soldier attempting to reach his trench while coming under repeated Ukrainian drone attacks. Although reports claim he evaded seven attacks, only three are visible in the released video.

The first two attacks involve grenades dropped by quadcopter drones, exploding close to the soldier. In the third, an FPV kamikaze drone pursues him and detonates just ahead of him. Despite the near misses, he manages to survive and eventually reaches the trenches with his supplies.

The footage highlights the growing danger for frontline infantry, where even crossing a short stretch of open ground can expose soldiers to repeated drone attacks.

snippet.title: NGIBUL NIH? masa ilmuwan tau usia fossil puluhan juta tahun lalu?
snippet.description:
Banyak yang ngira umur dinosaurus itu ditebak pakai "Carbon Dating" alias penanggalan karbon. Padahal itu mitos sains yang paling sering salah kaprah! 

Isotop Karbon-14 punya waktu paruh yang cepat banget, sekitar 5.730 tahun. 
Jadi dalam waktu 50.000 tahun, jejak karbon di fosil udah habis total tak tersisa. 

Untuk menentukan umur jutaan tahun, geolog pakai "Radiometric Dating" dengan menargetkan isotop yang umurnya panjang banget, seperti Uranium-235 atau Uranium-238 yang berubah jadi Timbal. 

Uranium ini nggak ditemukan di tulang dinosaurusnya, tapi terkunci di dalam kristal Zirkon dari abu letusan gunung berapi purba yang mengapit lapisan fosil! 

Keren ya, bumi menyimpan jam otomatismenya sendiri di dalam batu! Lu punya fosil atau koleksi batu akik nggak di rumah? 

Sources:

Prothero, D. R. (2003). Bringing Fossils to Life: An Introduction to Paleobiology. McGraw-Hill.

Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History. (n.d.). How Do We Know How Old Fossils Are?
